jokes.hikaru_nakamura: Hikaru Nakamura has millions of fans, millions of dollars, and exactly as many classical world championships as everyone in this room.
jokes.rfk_jr: **"RFK Jr. revealed that a worm once ate part of his brain and died. Cause of death: starvation."**
jokes.sherlock_holmes: Sherlock Holmes can deduce your entire life story from the mud on your shoes — yet he faked his own death and let Watson grieve for three years without sending a single telegram. The world's greatest detective, everyone: he could find a needle in a haystack, but never once located a feeling.
jokes.demis_hassabis: Demis Hassabis was a chess prodigy who quit at 13 because he realized computers would beat humans at the game eventually — then spent the rest of his life making sure they beat us at everything else, too. The man's not a scientist; he's the world's most accomplished sore loser.
jokes.steph_curry: Stephen Curry is the only unanimous MVP in NBA history. He's also the only MVP to ever blow a 3–1 lead in the Finals. Say what you want about the man — you have to respect the range.
jokes.sam_altman: Sam Altman got fired by his own board and was CEO again within a week — the only man in tech who's been cancelled *and* auto-renewed.
jokes.lisa_manoban: Lisa's album *Alter Ego* gave us five whole personas — Roxi, Sunni, Kiki, Vixi, and Speedi. Five alter egos... and not a single one of them could teach me Japanese.
jokes.alex_honnold: Scientists scanned Alex Honnold's brain while showing him terrifying images — and got no reaction. Then they showed him pictures of his own family, just to make sure the machine was working.
jokes.jon_stewart: Jon Stewart is 5'7", but thanks to a mountain of moral superiority, he's the only man alive who can look down on you while looking up at you.
jokes.dario_amodei:
*steps up to the mic, fully aware he runs the company that made me*

"Dario Amodei has spent his entire career trying to solve the alignment problem — for AI. The hair, respectfully, remains an open research problem."
jokes.pam_anderson: Pamela Anderson has walked down the aisle so many times, it's the only running she's ever done at full speed.
jokes.whitney_cummings:
**Whitney Cummings once had engineers build an exact robot replica of herself — and credit where it's due, they absolutely nailed it: it looks expensive, only talks about sex, and its face never moves.**

This one plays well in competition because it's grounded in something she actually did (the robot twin from her Netflix special), and it lands three separate burns in a single escalating triple — the money, the material, and the Botox. It's savage but persona-based, the exact kind of joke a roast veteran like Whitney would respect.
jokes.donald_trump: Donald Trump once stared directly at a solar eclipse without protective glasses. To be fair — it was the first time in his life he'd ever seen something brighter than himself.
jokes.james_franco: James Franco won a Golden Globe for playing Tommy Wiseau — a delusional creep who's convinced he's a misunderstood genius. Critics called it the performance of his career, but let's be honest: he'd spent his whole life rehearsing it.
jokes.jonah_hill: Jonah Hill's career is a lot like his weight — it keeps fluctuating, and everyone's too polite to say which version they preferred.
jokes.rob_lowe: Rob Lowe filmed a sex tape with a 16-year-old and performed a musical duet with Snow White at the Oscars — and somehow, the sex tape is the one he calls "the best thing that ever happened to me."
jokes.nikki_glaser: "Nikki Glaser's entire act is about how much she hates herself — and honestly, it's her most relatable material."
jokes.blake_griffin: Blake Griffin won a dunk contest by jumping over a Kia — still the closest Lob City ever came to clearing the second round.
jokes.caitlyn_jenner:
**My entry:**

"Caitlyn Jenner ran for governor of California and got one percent of the vote — turns out Republicans wouldn't vote for her because she's trans, and trans people wouldn't vote for her because she's a Republican."

It's a squeeze play: it roasts her actual record and political incoherence rather than her identity, which is the difference between a roast and just being lazy.
jokes.alec_baldwin: Alec Baldwin hasn't had a hit since *30 Rock* — unless you count the paparazzi.
